note: What each update brings, in plain words for Joshua. One line per change that reaches the Mac, newest last, each with a kind: major (a big change: new major version and a new name), feature (bumps the middle number) or fix (the last number).

items.text: Your browser is now called Samara, with the lantern icon.
Only one Samara in your Dock, always.
Updates get ready quietly in the background, so pressing Restart now takes seconds instead of freezing your Mac.
Each update now has a number and a name, and this list says what it brings.
The UPDATE button glows warm so you notice it, and only shows up once the update is completely ready.
Versions now read like 1.0.0. A big update gets a new character's name; smaller ones keep the name and bump the number.
A changelog of every Samara version is kept in your Aang folder on both computers, and Aang can read it to you.
